accent.custom.desc: Pick the exact colour for the ring. It is applied when you choose OK.
accent.custom.title: Custom accent colour
caption.default: Drop on an action · Shift / Ctrl / Alt to switch · Esc to cancel
caption.emptyTab: No actions in this tab for these files.
crop.hint: Drag to draw a new area, or move the frame and its corners. The same area applies to every image.
crop.title: Crop image
custom.arguments.hint: The command line. Placeholders are replaced for each file and paths are quoted for you.
custom.empty: No custom actions yet. Add one, or start from an example.
custom.enabled: Show this action in the ring
custom.error.missing: This custom action no longer exists.
custom.error.noOutput: The program finished but did not create the output file.
custom.error.timeout: The program did not finish in time and was stopped.
custom.name: Name
custom.output.hint: For conversions: the extension of the new file, such as docx. Leave empty for actions that create no file.
custom.placeholders: Placeholders: {file} the file, {files} every dropped file at once, {dir} its folder, {name} its name without extension, {ext} its extension, {out} the new file DragDone names for a conversion.
custom.problem.format: The output format may contain letters and digits only.
custom.problem.output: {out} is used, so set an output format.
custom.problem.types: List at least one file type, or * for any file.
custom.program.hint: A full path, or a program name found on PATH such as magick or pandoc.
custom.showWindow.desc: Useful for console tools that ask questions; output is not captured.
custom.shows: Ready. Shown in the {tab} ring for matching files.
custom.types.hint: Extensions or kinds, separated by commas: .png, .jpg, video, document. Use * for any file.
error.imageDecode: Could not read the image; its codec extension may be missing.
error.noPrinter: Excel needs an installed printer to make a PDF or XPS. Add Microsoft Print to PDF in Windows settings and try again.
error.noVideo: The file has no video track.
error.notOpenXml: This file is not a document DragDone can read.
error.office: Office could not convert the file.
error.passwordProtected: The file is password protected — remove the password and try again.
error.pdfOpen: Could not open the PDF; it may be password-protected.
error.print: Windows has no print action for this kind of file.
error.share: The share sheet is not available on this PC.
hint.autoTrim: Removes uniform borders around the image.
hint.compressAudio: Re-encodes audio at a lower bitrate while keeping it clear.
hint.compressBalanced: Balances size and quality; right for most uses.
hint.compressDoc: Re-encodes the pictures inside to shrink the file.
hint.compressImage: Shrinks the image file while keeping its look.
hint.compressLight: A small size reduction with minimal quality loss.
hint.compressPdf: Compresses PDF streams and drops unused objects.
hint.compressStrong: Smallest size; good for quick sending.
hint.docStats: Words, characters and length, copied to the clipboard.
hint.extract: Extracts the archive into a folder next to it.
hint.extractAudio: Saves the audio track in its original codec, no re-encoding.
hint.extractImages: Writes every picture inside to its own file.
hint.extractText: Writes the text to a .txt file beside it.
hint.freeCrop: Opens a window to choose the crop area.
hint.hash: Computes SHA-256 and copies it to the clipboard.
hint.mergePdf: Combines the files into one PDF in drag order.
hint.normalize: Brings loudness to a consistent level.
hint.print: Sends the file to the printer of its default app.
hint.share: Opens the Windows share sheet, including Nearby Sharing.
hint.shelf: Keeps the files on a floating shelf to drag out later.
hint.snapshot: Saves a frame from the middle of the clip as PNG.
hint.split: Saves each page as its own PDF.
hint.stripDocMeta: Removes author, company and edit history.
hint.stripMeta: Removes location and camera data before sharing.
hint.trimSilence: Removes silence at the start and end.
hint.zip: Puts the files into a ZIP next to them.
reason.filesOnly: This action works on files only, not folders.
reason.needsExcel: Requires Microsoft Excel on this PC.
reason.needsFfmpeg: Requires FFmpeg. Set its location in Settings.
reason.needsOffice: Requires Microsoft Office on this PC.
reason.needsPowerPoint: Requires Microsoft PowerPoint on this PC.
reason.needsPublisher: Requires Microsoft Publisher on this PC.
reason.needsVisio: Requires Microsoft Visio on this PC.
reason.needsWord: Requires Microsoft Word on this PC.
reason.sameFormat: The file is already in this format.
reason.singleOnly: Works on one file at a time.
reason.unsupported: This format is not supported for this action.
rename.exists: An item with that name already exists.
rename.invalid: The name contains characters that are not allowed.
rename.label: New name
rename.title: Rename
result.alreadyOptimal: Already optimal; no new file was created.
result.alreadyRatio: The image already has this ratio.
result.alreadySmaller: The image is already smaller than that.
result.alreadyThere: The files are already in that folder.
result.failed: The action could not be completed.
result.sameFormat: The file is already in that format.
result.singlePage: The file has one page; nothing to split.
result.undoFailed: Could not undo; the files may have changed.
settings.about.info: Version and where settings are stored.
settings.accent.desc: Applies to the radial menu immediately.
settings.accentStrength.desc: How far the accent colour carries into the ring.
settings.animateChanges.desc: Plays a shorter version of the opening animation when the ring changes.
settings.animation.desc: How the ring appears when it opens. The preview plays it after every change.
settings.animationMs.desc: Duration of the opening animation. Zero turns it off.
settings.appearance.info: The accent colour used by the menu and buttons.
settings.blur.desc: Soft shadow and blur behind the ring. Turn off for the lightest possible footprint.
settings.contrast.desc: Raises text contrast and deepens edges, so the ring stays readable over a busy wallpaper.
settings.density.desc: Spacing and type size inside the ring.
settings.diameter.desc: How large the menu draws. The automatic default reads well on most screens.
settings.dwell.desc: How long the pointer must rest before the ring appears.
settings.ffmpeg.desc: Required for video and audio. It is never downloaded automatically.
settings.ffmpeg.how: Install it with winget install Gyan.FFmpeg, place ffmpeg.exe next to DragDone.exe, or choose its location.
settings.frame.desc: Border around each sector. Zero leaves no outline.
settings.gap.desc: Gap in pixels. Zero draws one continuous ring.
settings.hover.desc: How strong the hover effect is.
settings.hoverEffect.desc: What a sector does while a drag rests on it.
settings.hoverMs.desc: How long a sector takes to change when the pointer arrives or leaves.
settings.jpegQuality.desc: Higher means better quality and larger files.
settings.keys.warn: Keep the three keys distinct. A key that is already held when the drag begins (for example Ctrl-drag to copy) does not summon the ring; press it again after the drag starts.
settings.labels.desc: What each sector shows. Automatic adds names only when there is room for them.
settings.language.desc: Follows Windows, or pins one. Applies immediately, including text direction.
settings.layout.desc: Donut is a thin ring, solid wheel fills the sectors, petals and fan are wheel variants, and orbit, honeycomb, tiles and diamonds float the items around an open centre.
settings.legend.hint: Switch tabs while the menu is open by pressing another key or hovering a tab name.
settings.mouseKey.note: Mouse buttons cannot open the menu: Windows cancels the file drag the moment one is pressed, so the dragged files never arrive. Pick another key.
settings.office.desc: Used to convert Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents to PDF.
settings.office.missing: Microsoft Office is not installed; text to PDF still works.
settings.offline: DragDone works offline and sends no data.
settings.output.besideHint: Results are saved in the original file's folder.
settings.output.info: Where results go and their quality. Existing files are never overwritten.
settings.paused.desc: The menu does not appear while dragging until resumed.
settings.preview.hint: Updates as you change anything above. What you see is what the ring does.
settings.preview.play.desc: Plays the opening animation in the preview.
settings.resultSeconds.desc: How long the result card stays before fading.
settings.rotated.desc: Turns labels with their sector. Off keeps every label upright.
settings.scope.anywhere.desc: Includes other apps that let you drag files out.
settings.scope.desc: Where DragDone listens for drags. Desktop and File Explorer covers the usual case.
settings.section.about.info: Version, settings folder and the introduction.
settings.section.appearance.info: Theme, colour and material. The preview below redraws with every change.
settings.section.custom.info: Add your own programs to the rings. A custom action runs a program on the dropped files; give it an output format and it becomes a conversion that saves beside the original.
settings.section.motion.info: How the ring opens and how sectors respond under the pointer.
settings.section.output.info: Where results go, and default quality.
settings.section.ring.info: Shape and size of the menu itself.
settings.section.shortcuts.info: Which key summons which set of actions, and how long a pause counts.
settings.section.themes.info: Share a look, or take one from someone else.
settings.section.tools.info: Optional local programs DragDone can use. Nothing is downloaded.
settings.section.types.info: Teach DragDone extensions it does not know, so those files get the rings of the kind you choose.
settings.startup.desc: DragDone runs in the background after sign-in.
settings.systemMotion.desc: Turns all motion off when Animation effects is off in Windows accessibility settings.
settings.tabBar.desc: The row of key buttons under the ring.
settings.theme.failed: That file could not be read as a DragDone theme.
settings.theme.files.desc: Appearance lives in its own theme.json, separate from paths and machine settings, so a look can be shared as one file.
settings.theme.mode.desc: Follow Windows, or pin the light or the dark look.
settings.theme.preset.desc: A starting point for the whole look. Adjust anything after choosing one.
settings.title: DragDone Settings
settings.tools.info: All processing happens on this PC. These optional tools extend the supported formats.
settings.translucent.desc: Lets the desktop show through. Turning this off makes the ring fully opaque.
settings.trigger.info: Controls when the menu appears and which key opens each tab.
settings.trigger.modifier: Only when a key is pressed
settings.trigger.modifier.desc: Normal drag and drop stays exactly as it is.
settings.trigger.pause: On a key press or when the drag pauses
settings.trigger.pause.desc: The Convert menu opens if the pointer rests briefly mid-drag.
settings.triggerMode.desc: The key alone, or also a short pause while dragging.
shelf.dragAll.tip: Drag every item at once to anywhere.
shelf.hint: Drop files here to hold them, then drag them to their destination.
shelf.title: Shelf
theme.terminal.desc: Outlined ring, labels along the arc.
theme.windows.desc: Borrows your Windows accent and material.
tray.hookFailed: Drag detection could not start. Restart DragDone.
types.empty: No extra file types. DragDone already recognises the common image, video, audio, document and archive formats.
types.invalid: Enter an extension made of letters and digits, such as .jxl.
welcome.heading: Drag • Press • Done
welcome.lead: DragDone stays out of sight until you need it. Everyday file tasks take a single drag.
welcome.step1.desc: Start dragging one or more files from the desktop or File Explorer.
welcome.step2.desc: Press Shift, Ctrl or Alt while dragging and the menu opens around the pointer.
welcome.step3.desc: Drop on an action. The result is saved next to the original, and you can undo at once.
welcome.title: Welcome to DragDone
welcome.tray: DragDone lives in the notification area next to the clock.
